Hey y’all!

Welcome to my progress journal of life in my 30’s 🤍

Here you’ll find daily-style vlogs and clips of me balancing motherhood, the grind, self-care, healing, and growth — while figuring out who I’m meant to be along the way.

Girl if you can relate, stay tuned and join the community by subscribing and showing love in the comments 💋
